id: 31_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Clean or replace the lens protector
title: 激光焊接机保护镜片的清洁与更换
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/31_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Clean or replace the lens protector.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/31_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Clean or replace the lens protector/src.py

points.K1: 功率下降、火花变弱，查镜片

shots.scene: 欣欣捏着一片小小的圆形镜片，对着光看
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small round protective lens up to the light and looks through it.
shots.narration: 这一课讲焊枪保护镜片的清洁和更换。
overlay: 激光焊接机保护镜片的清洁与更换

shots.scene: 阿杰焊接时火花明显变弱，皱起眉头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing a face shield, welds but the spark is weak and dim; he frowns.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现，焊接火花越来越弱了。

shots.scene: 阿杰一边开着机，一边去拆焊枪顶盖
shots.prompt_en: With the machine still switched on, the young male student starts to open the top cover of the welding gun.
shots.narration: 他没关机，就想拆开焊枪看看。

shots.scene: 老李快步过来按住他的手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hurries over and puts a hand on his to stop him.
shots.narration: 老李拦住他：先关机！

shots.section_title: 功率下降、火花变弱，查镜片
shots.scene: 火花强弱对比图，弱火花旁一个镜片图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a bright strong weld spark and a weak dim spark, with a lens icon beside the weak one. No people.
shots.narration: 功率下降、火花变弱，可能是镜片脏了坏了。
overlay: 功率下降、火花变弱，查镜片

shots.scene: 焊枪剖面示意：镜片仓就在光路上
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway diagram of the welding gun: the lens compartment sits directly in the dashed laser beam path. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片仓就在激光光路上，

shots.scene: 老李关掉电源开关，拔下钥匙
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the main power and removes the key plug from the machine.
shots.narration: 打开它之前，关机、拔下钥匙。

shots.scene: 开机状态下打开焊枪的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an open welding gun compartment while the machine indicator is lit, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开着机拆镜片，绝对不行。

shots.scene: 老李把焊枪拿到一张干净整洁的台面上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer carries the welding gun to a clean, uncluttered bench away from the dusty welding area.
shots.narration: 换到干净、少灰尘的地方操作。

shots.scene: 老李用白色无尘布擦拭焊枪外壳
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wipes the outside of the welding gun with a white lint-free cloth.
shots.narration: 先用无尘布把焊枪外面擦干净，

shots.scene: 老李洗手后戴上蓝色无尘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer washes his hands and pulls on blue lint-free gloves.
shots.narration: 再洗手，或者戴上无尘手套。

shots.scene: 老李拆下焊枪顶部的小盖子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the small cover on top of the welding gun.
shots.narration: 拆下焊枪顶部的盖子，

shots.scene: 老李抽出镜片座
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer slides the lens holder out of the gun.
shots.narration: 取出保护镜片。

shots.scene: 镜片仓口盖上一个防尘盖
shots.prompt_en: A small dust cap is placed over the open lens compartment of the welding gun. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片取出后，仓口马上盖好。

shots.scene: 灰尘飞屑落进敞开的镜片仓的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of dust and debris falling into an open lens compartment, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 灰尘落进光路，出光时会被烧蚀。

shots.scene: 镜片对着灯光，能看到几个小污点
shots.prompt_en: The lens held up to the light shows a few small spots of dirt. No people.
shots.narration: 对着光检查镜片。

shots.scene: 老李用棉签蘸少量酒精，轻轻擦镜片
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer dips a cotton swab in a little alcohol and gently wipes the lens.
shots.narration: 有污点，用棉签蘸少量酒精轻轻擦。

shots.scene: 擦干净的镜片装回焊枪
shots.prompt_en: The cleaned lens holder is slid back into the welding gun. No people.
shots.narration: 擦干净后装回焊枪。

shots.scene: 一片发黑、有烧痕的镜片
shots.prompt_en: A protective lens with dark burn marks and a crack. No people.
shots.narration: 烧坏了、严重脏污擦不掉的，

shots.scene: 烧坏的镜片和新镜片之间一个箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from the burned lens to a new clear lens. No people.
shots.narration: 就要换新的。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着烧坏的镜片，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the burned lens with a question mark beside it.
shots.narration: 镜片烧坏，是在提醒我们有问题。

shots.scene: 飞溅、反射、气不足三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: weld spatter dots, a reflected beam arrow, and a gas cylinder with a low gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 可能是飞溅、回反射，或者保护气不足。

shots.scene: 老李在空白维护记录本上写下情况
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer writes in a blank maintenance logbook.
shots.narration: 查明原因，记下来，再报告负责人。

shots.scene: 老李从镜片座上取下白色垫圈和旧镜片
shots.prompt_en: Wearing gloves, the facility engineer removes the white gasket and the old lens from the holder.
shots.narration: 戴着手套，取下垫圈和旧镜片。

shots.scene: 裂开的旧镜片放进碎玻璃收集盒
shots.prompt_en: A cracked old lens is dropped into a rigid broken glass collection box. No people.
shots.narration: 碎裂的镜片是玻璃锐器，

shots.scene: 碎镜片丢进普通垃圾桶的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a broken lens thrown into an ordinary trash bag, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 放进碎玻璃盒，不扔普通垃圾桶。

shots.scene: 老李从透明小盒里取出新镜片
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes a new lens in sealed film out of a small clear box.
shots.narration: 取出新镜片。

shots.scene: 手指按在镜片玻璃上的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a fingertip pressing on the lens glass, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手指和工具都不要碰玻璃面。

shots.scene: 老李用干净棉签轻扫镜片表面
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gently brushes the lens surface with a clean cotton swab.
shots.narration: 不小心沾了灰，用棉签清洁。

shots.scene: 老李撕掉镜片上面的保护膜，放进镜片座
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer peels the protective film off the top of the new lens and sets it into the holder.
shots.narration: 撕掉上面的保护膜，装进镜片座，

shots.scene: 老李撕掉另一面的保护膜
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer peels the film off the other side of the lens.
shots.narration: 再撕掉另一面的膜。

shots.scene: 老李把白色垫圈压回镜片上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the white gasket back onto the lens in the holder.
shots.narration: 装回垫圈。

shots.scene: 老李按方向把镜片座插回焊枪，压到位
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer slides the lens holder back into the gun in the correct orientation and presses it home.
shots.narration: 按正确方向装回焊枪，压到位。

shots.scene: 老李装回焊枪顶盖
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer refits the top cover of the welding gun.
shots.narration: 盖好顶盖。

shots.scene: 开机后焊嘴下出现一个清晰的红点，打勾
shots.prompt_en: After switching on, a sharp round red dot appears below the nozzle, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 装好开机，先看红光清不清晰。

shots.scene: 红点模糊、残缺的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a blurred, broken red dot, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 红点模糊残缺，说明没装好，不能出光。

shots.scene: 老李戴好面罩，在受控区内试焊
shots.prompt_en: Wearing a laser face shield, the facility engineer test-welds inside the curtained controlled area.
shots.narration: 确认正常，再按规程试焊。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with icons behind: a power switch off, a dust cap, a cotton swab and a clear lens.
shots.narration: 先关机，仓盖好，擦得净，不碰玻璃。

shots.scene: 图标：问号、碎玻璃盒、红点
shots.prompt_en: Icons in a row: a question mark, a broken glass box and a red dot. No people.
shots.narration: 烧坏查原因，碎片进锐器盒，红光正常再出光。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 镜片干净，光路安全。下次见！
